@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M21AEPX6A1KRH0TQ0D4QV9CP
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 9b80
+title: 'PermissionView: request card with options, subject, comment, terminal link, switch to auto (plan §9 E, §12)'
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/HumanInTheLoop/PermissionView.swift` and `PendingRequestsHost.swift`, per plan.md §9 E and §12.
+
+- `PermissionView(request:)`: a glass card with the required `title`, the `description`, and the subject: a tool call summary (title and kind) or a command with `command`, `cwd`, and a link to the `TerminalView` when `terminalId` is set. One button per option from the request, in the order given; `allowAlways` and `rejectAlways` are visually secondary; the primary allow uses `.glassProminent`. A comment field appears on a reject choice. "Switch to auto" appears when a `mode` config option with an `auto` value exists and calls `setConfigOption` before answering. Esc maps to `cancelled`.
+- The card calls `AgentThreadActions.respond(to:_:)` with `PermissionDecision`.
+- `PendingRequestsHost`: the piece of `AgentThreadView` that renders `thread.pendingPermissions`, `pendingElicitations`, and `pendingAuthorizations` in-thread at the bottom, one card each, and moves VoiceOver focus to the newest card.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Four options render four buttons in request order.
+- [ ] Tapping reject shows the comment field; submitting passes the comment in the decision.
+- [ ] Esc sends `cancelled`.
+- [ ] A new pending request moves accessibility focus to the card.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/HumanInTheLoop/PermissionViewHostedTests.swift`: buttons, comment, Esc, focus, through `NoopThreadActions`.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
